questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution states that persons who voluntarily acquire citizenship of a foreign state are NOT eligible to be citizens of India?
As of July 2024, which of the following is the longest National Highway in India?
The level of national income does NOT determine the level of which of the following variables?
options: Demand and supply of a good
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Demand and supply of a good) है।

questions.question: Fuse in an electric circuit is used for _________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (protecting the circuits) है।

questions.question: Palaeolithic Period is also known as ______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (old stone age) है।

questions.question: The Constitution of India allows for a maximum of how many representatives from the Union Territories in the Lok Sabha?
Which event led to the suspension of the Non-Cooperation Movement by Mahatma Gandhi in 1922?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The Chauri Chaura Incident) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct about literacy rates in India as per Census 2011?
options: Both Nagaland and Orissa crossed 80% in the literacy rate.
In two states of India, Kerala and Goa, the literacy rate was higher for the females.
Andaman and Nicobar Islands had the literacy rate above 85%.
Puducherry showed a remarkable rise in the literacy rate compared to 2001 Census, with 92% literacy rate in 2011.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Andaman and Nicobar Islands had the literacy rate above 85%.) है।
